rawContent: Amazing how Asian Americans get called "race traitors" when we defend affirmative action, #BlackLivesMatter, indigenous peoples. Yes, Asian Americans are oppressed & invisible. And yes, I get to love AND criticize my people AND be in solidarity w/ other humans in OUR society.

From a @UFT Delegate today- "The UFT delegate assembly just ruled MORE’s resolution to support the Black Lives Matter week of action “out of order” and didn’t allow a discussion or vote about it." @MOREcaucusNYC #blm #BlackLivesMatter #blmedu
